groupings.title: Project language
groupings.description: Establish shared terminology and review its use across the project. Includes guidance for handling evidence gaps constructively.

groupings.title: Project writing
groupings.description: Produce actionable implementation tasks and useful decision records. Includes technical documentation guidance organised around reader needs.

groupings.title: Product content
groupings.description: Explain product value through credible marketing content and provide clear interface guidance that reflects actual application behaviour.

groupings.title: Architecture
groupings.description: Apply the established backend and frontend architecture rules while preserving their technical meaning.

groupings.title: General writing
groupings.description: Write reports, research findings, summaries and other prose without a narrower specialist.

groupings.title: Professional outreach
groupings.description: Investigate commercial possibilities and write authentic individual outreach, with CRM history and current evidence when available.

groupings.title: Upstream product and writing skills
groupings.description: Independently installable upstream skills for product positioning, storytelling, open-source adoption, README craft, editing and developer marketing. Each retains its source instructions and attribution.
